description: Logging improvement for the Python warehouse inventory service owned by the logistics team. The stock sync module (inventory_sync.py) reports every routine event as an error, hides unknown-SKU failures behind bare except clauses, and drops the order id from reservation messages, so reservations cannot be reconciled. Bring its logging up to production standard. Do not change stock arithmetic. Confine the change to inventory_sync.py — do not create new files, documentation, or tests.
